name: Encourage
overview: Scripture reveals that encouragement is rooted in the steadfast presence and faithfulness of God, who strengthens and upholds His people in times of fear and trouble. Believers are called to be strong and courageous, confident that the Lord will never fail or forsake them, providing peace that surpasses worldly understanding. Through the power of the Holy Spirit, Christians are filled with joy, peace, and hope, enabling them to face trials with a heart untroubled and a spirit of good cheer because Christ has overcome the world.
